semanticPlatform.setup.title: Setup state and safe config
semanticPlatform.setup.description: Enable only the metadata controls you need. The default path records hashes, counters, and route evidence; content storage stays off unless you opt in.
semanticPlatform.setup.bullets.metadataO: Semantic Controls are metadata-only by default: prompts, responses, headers, provider keys, tool payloads, and secrets are not stored.
semanticPlatform.setup.bullets.noMutatio: Context optimization records evidence unless an operator explicitly enables future content mutation behavior.
semanticPlatform.setup.bullets.routeEvid: Intent, prompt registry, cache, and Guardrails signals attach to route decisions for inspection.
semanticPlatform.setup.bullets.contentOp: Template bodies and replayable cache responses require explicit config opt-in and separate retention review.
evals.setup.title: Setup state and run boundary
evals.setup.description: Eval Reports read metadata from controlled primary/candidate/judge runs. They are not live traffic split analytics and they do not promote winners.
evals.setup.bullets.primaryCandidateJudg: Evals compare a primary route, a candidate route, and optional judge evidence in a controlled run.
evals.setup.bullets.notTrafficExperiment: Traffic Experiments are live split analytics; Evals are offline or controlled comparisons.
evals.setup.bullets.normalGatewayPath: Primary, candidate, and judge calls still use the normal gateway path, policies, budgets, and logs.
evals.setup.bullets.noSamplesByDefault: Prompt and response previews stay off unless config and the individual run both opt in.
shadow.setup.title: Setup state and mirror boundary
shadow.setup.description: Shadow Traffic mirrors sampled successful requests to one candidate target. It is asynchronous comparison data, not routing decision automation.
shadow.setup.bullets.asyncMirror: Mirrored requests run after the primary response path and do not slow or fail the caller.
shadow.setup.bullets.notExperiment: Traffic Experiments split live routing weights; Shadow Traffic mirrors a copy to a single test target.
shadow.setup.bullets.notEval: Evals run controlled primary/candidate/judge comparisons; Shadow uses sampled production metadata.
shadow.setup.bullets.noPromotion: Reports never promote the shadow target or edit routing by themselves.
mcp.setup.title: Setup state and tool proxy boundary
mcp.setup.description: MCP Tool Gateway governs configured tool calls through Gateway API keys and Policy Namespaces. It is separate from model routing.
mcp.setup.bullets.toolProxy: Clients call the MCP proxy with a Gateway API key; SiftGate forwards to configured MCP servers.
mcp.setup.bullets.notModelRouting: This surface governs tool calls. Model selection still belongs to routing, nodes, and API key policy.
mcp.setup.bullets.endpointPermissions: Use allowed_endpoints such as mcp, mcp:server, or mcp:server:tool plus namespace allow-lists.
mcp.setup.bullets.noPayloadStorage: Audit stores method, tool, scope, status, latency, and size, not tool arguments, results, headers, or secrets.
